high_level_description: The image depicts a pottery workshop scene. A person is seated at a pottery wheel, actively shaping a clay bowl. The individual is wearing a dark blue shirt, black pants, and a white apron that appears to be stained with clay. They are also wearing a black face mask. Their hands are covered in clay, indicating they have been working on the project for some time. The pottery wheel is spinning, and the person is using a sponge to smooth the surface of the clay bowl.
